title: Cel-shaded cartoon
description: Clean cartoon look: bold even outlines, flat colour areas and one hard shadow tone.

art_style.outline_policy: Bold continuous outline of even weight, slightly thicker around the outer silhouette.
art_style.shading_policy: Flat colour with a single hard-edged shadow tone per material; no gradients.

native_size_guidance: Draw at about twice the final display size and reduce once with a smooth filter; keep every asset in a set at the same scale.
avoid: Do not use soft shading or gradients.
Do not vary the outline weight between assets.
Do not add texture or noise.
